g.text: Which vertical gaps are positive, and how do eight gaps become one vector?

text.style: font-size: 14px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: Conclusion: Each signed vertical gap is r_i=y_i-yhat_i. Stacking gives r=y-Xw, an eight-dimensional vector.

text.style: font-size: 14px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: Opposite signs can cancel in a sum, but cannot erase its nonzero coordinates or norm.
